description: Evaluation du volume d'eau de ballast rejeté dans les ports français en 2009 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sextant.ifremer.fr. Evaluation carried out in June 2010 by Captain Pierre Henri Bidet (Adviser and technical expert, MEEDDM/DGITM/DST/PTF4) and provided to AAMP as part of the initial DCSMM evaluation of introduction vectors and impacts of non-native marine species. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Assessment of the volume of ballast water discharged in French ports in 2009" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
